## Episode Thesis

The episode centres on France's worsening public finances: debt at 115% of GDP, the 10-year yield at 4.87%, the widest French-German spread since 2011, and contagion into Italian, Greek and Belgian yields. A Di analyst warns this could turn into a new euro crisis that Sweden could not escape, since the Greek crisis twice pushed the Stockholm exchange down about 20%. In the near term he expects a strong Q3 2026 report season for Swedish exporters, helped by a weaker krona, easier currency comparisons, likely upward estimate revisions and a strong Nordic consumer. No individual equities were discussed beyond sponsor and platform mentions.
